summary: Qorshe dhammaystiran (Implementation Plan) oo loogu talagalay dhisidda Admin Dashboard & CMS casri ah oo ku shaqaynaya Supabase (Auth & Database). Waxaa ku jira qaab-dhismeedka keydka xogta (SQL Schema), maamulka Mashaariicda, Waayo-aragnimada & Waxbarashada, Marag-furka macaamiisha, Sanduuqa farriimaha soo dhaca, iyo Master Prompt-ka tooska ah.
